newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady as demand rises.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady as demand rises.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Monday as a higher demand from spinners absorbed rising supplies from ginneries, dealers said.
The prices are likely to remain stable as spinners are picking up fresh quality stocks arriving from the main growing Punjab province, they said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,150 ($58.01) and the MNH-93 at 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), dealers said.
